title: Add stress to Plumed calculator
description:
This MR adds the capability of computing stresses to the Plumed calculator. This is needed for NPT molecular dynamics with ASE. The new code obtains the stress from the base calculator and adds the additional stress from bias potentials computed by the Plumed calculator.

The implementation has been tested by comparing the numerical and analytical stress. Also, previous unit tests have been updated and new unit tests have been added.

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [x] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://ase-lib.org/development/contribute.html)
- [x] [**Doc strings** in code changed in this MR are up to date.](https://ase-lib.org/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code)
- [x] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://ase-lib.org/development/tests.html)
- [x] [**Changes** have been added in `changelog.d` using `scriv`.](https://ase-lib.org/development/writing_changelog.html)
- [~] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)

+@pytest.mark.calculator_lite()
+@pytest.mark.calculator('plumed')
+def test_stress_unbiased(factory):
+    """Test that stress equals unbiased stress when PLUMED adds no bias."""
+    atoms = Atoms('CO', positions=[[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1]])
+    atoms.set_cell([[10, 0, 0], [0, 10, 0], [0, 0, 10]])
+    atoms.set_pbc(True)
+
+    ps = 1000 * units.fs
+    set_plumed = [f"UNITS LENGTH=A TIME={1 / ps} ENERGY={units.mol / units.kJ}",
+                  "d: DISTANCE ATOMS=1,2",
+                  "PRINT ARG=d STRIDE=1 FILE=COLVAR"]
+
+    with factory.calc(calc=EMT(),
+                      input=set_plumed,
+                      timestep=1,
+                      atoms=atoms) as calc:
+        calc.calculate()
+        stress_total = calc.results['stress']
+        stress_unbiased = calc.calc.get_stress(atoms)
+
+    # Since no bias, stress should equal unbiased
+    assert stress_total == approx(stress_unbiased, abs=1e-10)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.calculator_lite()
+@pytest.mark.calculator('plumed')
+def test_stress_shape(factory):
+    """Test that stress has the correct shape and is computed."""
+    atoms = Atoms('H2', positions=[[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0.74]])
+
+    set_plumed = ["d: DISTANCE ATOMS=1,2",
+                  "UPPER_WALLS ARG=d AT=0.06 KAPPA=1"]
+
+    with factory.calc(calc=EMT(),
+                      input=set_plumed,
+                      timestep=1,
+                      atoms=atoms) as calc:
+        calc.calculate()
+        stress = calc.results['stress']
+
+    assert isinstance(stress, np.ndarray)
+    assert stress.shape == (6,)
+    # Check it's not all zeros (since bias is added)
+    assert not np.allclose(stress, 0)
+
